November: the fog print

A three-color screenprint of the harbor in low fog.

Members receive one print each month, numbered by hand.

This edition runs to two hundred copies, then the screens retire.

Framing available in oak, ash, or simple black aluminum.

Shipping is flat rate worldwide, tracked and insured.

Gift memberships ship with a hand-stamped welcome card.

Past prints occasionally return when members move abroad.

Studio visits run on the first Saturday of each month.

Poster Club — ships from Glasgow
